high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "richertoday." The post is titled "Govt. Regulations" and discusses Amazon's business model worldwide. The text explains that Amazon operates through an inventory model, where it purchases products in bulk from sellers at low prices and sells them to customers at significant discounts. The visual part of the post includes a graphic illustration: On the left side, there is a sign with the word "WHOLESALE" written on it.
